formulation.route_semantics: all exact feasible unordered tie-inclusive top-2 pairs
formulation.pair_branch: guarded shared-input two-expert F0 range-only McCormick relaxation
formulation.union: one pair selector per branch and bounded homogenization of every branch HZ
formulation.nonlinear_gate_encoding: no exp, division, or symbolic sigmoid; same guarded scalar gate range as Route A F0

budget_schedule: natural property order; after shared pair propagation, each remaining property receives an equal share of the remaining 900-second row deadline

numerical_safety.certifying_objective: finite mip_dual_bound for MILP; status-0 optimum for pure LP; never a non-optimal primal incumbent

claim_boundary: Monolithic means one disjunctive MILP per property over every feasible pair and both experts in each pair.
The formulation is exact for the union of supplied F0 relaxations, not an exact symbolic sigmoid graph.
F0 semantics and support-derived bounds are shared with the Route A comparator.
A negative relaxation incumbent is UNKNOWN unless its recovered input violates the full selected-softmax model.
Runtime is descriptive on a common frozen cohort; the pre-existing Route A reference was not interleaved in this run.
The immutable Route A reference and prior artifacts are never overwritten.
